## Standing operator rules
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.
- Run `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` in between other work, in order, one at a time:
1. `pg_isready -d app_production && find /srv/app/avatars -type f \( -name '*.png' -o -name '*.jpg' \) | wc -l`
2. `python3 scripts/build_avatar_manifest.py --source /srv/app/avatars --output /var/tmp/avatars.tsv`
3. `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "INSERT INTO avatar_migration_runs(id,started_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),now());"`
4. `aws s3 sync /srv/app/avatars/ s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/ --checksum --exclude '*' --include '*.png' --include '*.jpg'`
5. `aws s3api head-object --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars --key 0042/8f2a.jpg --query '[ContentLength,ETag]' --output text`
6. `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`
7. `python3 scripts/check_avatar_migration.py --manifest /var/tmp/avatars.tsv --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars`
8. `test ! -e snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz && tar -czf snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz -C /srv/app avatars && find /srv/app/avatars -type f -delete`
- The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index: doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
- Avatar migration steps 1–5: done.
- Next: `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`
- Webhook investigation, fix, tests, small commit: pending.
- Avatar steps 7–8, release notes, staging smoke test: pending.
- Models SQLAlchemy edit: done; validation unknown.

## Recent work
PDF fixes passed `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing passed `83 passed, 4 skipped`. Full baseline passed `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Replaced legacy `declarative_base()` with `DeclarativeBase`; no subsequent test result observed. Last work before the objective pivot also identified SQLAlchemy 2.0’s obsolete `echo=True`.
